credits.title: Gajab Raat
credits.overview: A corrupt, troubled cop's night spirals out of control when a reluctant act of mercy toward an injured girl pulls him into a deadly web of crime.

credits.title: The Storm, the Calm. The Madness, the Magic.
credits.overview: At his lowest, with nothing left, a glimpse of her earrings sparks a fire within: A purpose? Or just another illusion?  Shot on a single roll of 8mm film.

credits.title: Deva
credits.overview: Dev Ambre, a ruthless cop, loses his memory in an accident just after he has finished solving a murder case and now has to reinvestigate it while keeping his memory loss a secret from everyone except DCP Farhan Khan.

credits.title: Fighter
credits.overview: As India faces a militant attack in Kashmir, the country’s best combat aviators join forces under a reckless yet brilliant squadron leader to form 'Air Dragons', faces mortal dangers and their inner demons.
